direct_observations: The Ford oil-pan installation drawing explicitly calls for 5/16-18 x .87 screw and washer assembly, 25 places.
The drawing depicts screws and washers clamping the pan flange; it is an exploded service illustration rather than a dimensioned hole-pattern drawing.
candidate_assumptions: Thirteen stations on one side rail and twelve on the other are solely an illustrative arrangement preserving the supported total count.
All station coordinates, block pads, screw-head dimensions, washer dimensions, thread form details, clearances, captive retention and engagement are unverified.
Existing pan and side-gasket profiles are retained apart from clearance holes; the applicable continuous molded-rubber/end sealing is not completed.
